architecture: v1.1 actor-critic e-prop, stage A (recurrent MaleCNS core entirely frozen)
preserved_from_v11: MaleCNS v1.0 2,040-neuron subgraph and body IDs
LIF membrane dynamics and transmitter sign rule
deterministic seeding and greedy evaluation methodology

actor_lr.reason: Snake's mean absolute TD error is about 0.17 against 0.3-0.5 on catch and dodge, so the same rate produces far smaller updates. Measured development food at actor_lr 0.4 / 1.5 / 4.0 / 8.0 was 0.35 / 0.65 / 1.35 / 1.95; at the v1.1 rate Snake did not learn.

entropy_coefficient.reason: With TD errors near 0.06-0.17 the entropy gradient dominated the reward gradient and the policy never differentiated: action entropy stayed at 1.22 of a 1.386 maximum.

exploration_floor.reason: A forced random action in Snake is frequently fatal, so a 10 percent floor caps achievable survival. Catch and dodge have no terminal failure state.

training_episodes.reason: Snake episodes start at about five steps, so a 600-episode budget supplies roughly a twentieth of the updates catch and dodge receive.

reward: eat food +1.0, death -1.0, step penalty -0.01; no distance shaping was needed
environment: 8x8 grid, start length 3, max 200 steps, 64-step starvation cap, four absolute actions, immediate 180-degree reversal refused
sensory_encoding: 21 normalised channels: relative food direction (4), normalised food distance (1), heading one-hot (4), immediate danger (4), 3x3 local occupancy (8); Bernoulli injection into visual-projection neurons
frozen_components: action decoder (greedy softmax mode at evaluation)
training duration (4,000 episodes, no early stopping)
development_seed_rule: training 7,000,000 + 10,000*dev_seed + episode; evaluation 7,500,000 block; feature fitting 7,200,000 block
seed_disjointness: Snake development and confirmatory blocks are disjoint from each other and from every v1 and v1.1 block; tests/test_snake.py asserts this

criteria: food eaten improves from before to after training on every seed
held-out food eaten exceeds the random policy by more than 0.5 on every seed
the policy stays state-dependent: state_dependence above 0.05 and final action entropy above 0.1

resource_guard: 120 s per independently guarded process; trials checkpoint at episode boundaries and resume in a fresh process rather than raising any limit
